name: openra-migration
description: OpenRA → Babylon.js Web 3D migration team. Task prompt is set at spawn time.

members.name: team-lead
members.role: Task coordination, routing, progress tracking. Does NOT write code.

members.name: architect
members.role: Analyze OpenRA source, write Work Requirement Document, resolve dependencies.

members.name: developer
members.role: Implement TypeScript + unit tests following migration docs.

members.name: reviewer
members.role: 5-dimension code review: docs compliance, completeness, efficiency, bugs, format.

members.name: acceptance-tester
members.role: Create manual visual acceptance test pages for modules not verifiable by automated tests. Can commit test code.

members.name: docs-manager
members.role: Update migration docs, progress tracker, and commit after review approval.
